references.text: Jesus expresses his mission to seek and save what was lost, which reflects the purpose of His coming as mentioned in Matthew 18:11.
Jesus refers to His intention to come to call sinners, not the righteous, to repentance, which aligns with His mission to save what is lost.
God sent His Son into the world not to condemn the world, but that the world might be saved through Him, emphasizing Jesus' saving mission.
The Lord expresses His desire to gather the remnant of His sheep, which reflects Jesus' mission to save the lost.
